fixtures.description: Creating the first published revision of a new workstream does not require an expected-current-version precondition.
A new published revision is appended only when its expected current pointer matches, and it explicitly supersedes that current revision.
A draft revision records the published baseline it was prepared from, but it is not a published supersession and does not move the current pointer.
Appending a new revision to an existing workstream without stating its expected current published revision must fail closed.
fixtures.expectedFailure: The append omits expectedCurrentBreedingPipelineVersionDbId.

fixtures.description: A concurrent publish that has already advanced the current pointer must cause a stale append precondition to fail.
fixtures.expectedFailure: The expected current version no longer matches the server's current published revision.

fixtures.description: A published successor must explicitly identify the current published version it supersedes or corrects, not a different historical version.
fixtures.expectedFailure: The successor relationship does not identify the current published revision.

fixtures.description: Withdrawing the current published revision is a new immutable revision tied to the exact current version and guarded by the matching precondition.
A withdrawal revision cannot clear the current pointer unless it identifies the exact current published version being withdrawn.
fixtures.expectedFailure: The withdrawal revision points to a version other than the current published revision.

fixtures.description: A scalar threshold must not be combined with either numeric range bounds or exact-decimal range bounds.
fixtures.expectedFailure: threshold is a scalar target and cannot be combined with numeric or exact-decimal range bounds.

fixtures.description: All BrAPI list identifier filters are paired with the issuing server; population filters also include the exact resource type. Equal dbIds from distinct servers remain distinct authority tuples.

fixtures.expectedFailure: programDbId and programServer must be supplied together.
fixtures.description: A BrAPI identifier list filter without its issuing server must fail closed.

fixtures.expectedFailure: populationDbId, populationServer, and populationResourceType must be supplied together.
fixtures.description: A population/family identifier and server are insufficient without the exact owning BrAPI resource type.

fixtures.expectedFailure: Duplicate authority-qualified reference tuple.
fixtures.description: The same BrAPI resource tuple must not be duplicated, while a same-valued dbId from another server remains a distinct tuple.
A draft cannot use a published supersession relationship to claim that it replaces the current published revision.
fixtures.expectedFailure: Draft revisions must use a non-superseding baseline relationship.

fixtures.description: The same version identifier scoped to a different pipeline identity must not replay or disclose the existing pipeline revision.
fixtures.expectedFailure: Replay identity is scoped to the owning logical pipeline; cross-pipeline version-ID collisions must conflict without disclosure.

fixtures.description: A first-registration request cannot overwrite an already-created logical pipeline when its prior existence was not observed.
fixtures.expectedFailure: Concurrent first-creation collision must be resolved atomically; the losing request must re-read and append with an explicit expected-current precondition.
